issue.author: regehr
issue.body:
here's a function:
```llvm
define i32 @f(i32 %0) {
  %2 = sub nsw i32 %0, -2147483648
  %3 = icmp sgt i32 %2, 0
  %4 = select i1 %3, i32 1, i32 0
  ret i32 %4
}
```
with global isel we're lowering it like this:
```
~/reduce$ ~/llvm-project/for-alive/bin/llc -global-isel -o - reduced.ll 
	.build_version macos, 15, 0
	.section	__TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions
	.globl	_f                              ; -- Begin function f
	.p2align	2
_f:                                     ; @f
	.cfi_startproc
; %bb.0:
	mov	w8, #-2147483648                ; =0x80000000
	cmn	w0, w8
	cset	w0, gt
	ret
	.cfi_endproc
                                        ; -- End function
.subsections_via_symbols
~/reduce$ 
```
this code returns 0 for f(2147483649). however, the answer should be 1 and that is what we get if we run the code generated by the SDAG backend.

comments.author: davemgreen
comments.body: We might need to drop the nsw flags from the G_SUB as we convert it to a G_ADD, in the `sub_to_add` combine.

issue.title: integer math miscompile from AArch64 global isel backend
